tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Window background behind panels: the gutter around the board and between bays.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Lanes, inspector panels, usage cards. The default ground for every text token.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Sidebar, the callsign cell at the left of each lane, input wells.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Menu bar popover, menus, command palette. Always paired with shadow-popover.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Pointer hover on lanes, rows and menu items.

tokens.name: surface-selected
tokens.usage: The selected lane or row (the one the inspector shows). Selection is neutral, never a status hue.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between lanes and between lane segments, panel edges. Decorative only: nothing is told apart by line alone.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of controls (search field, secondary buttons, keycaps). At least 3:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and callsigns on every surface token, neutral-tint and attn-tint. Also the focus ring.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text on every surface: lane headlines, excerpts, button labels in ghost buttons. The Working glyph and meter fill.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Meta text on every surface and neutral-tint: timestamps, repo and branch lines, counts, column labels. The Idle and Stopped glyphs.

tokens.name: fill-strong
tokens.usage: Primary button fill (one per view: New session, Open).

tokens.name: on-fill-strong
tokens.usage: Text and icons on fill-strong.

tokens.name: attn
tokens.usage: Needs-you text on every surface and on attn-tint. Amber means only you can unblock this: never use it for anything else.

tokens.name: attn-solid
tokens.usage: The Needs-you diamond and other Needs-you marks. 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: attn-tint
tokens.usage: Background of Needs-you pills and of a Needs-you lane's callsign cell.

tokens.name: on-attn
tokens.usage: Text on attn-solid (counts inside a solid Needs-you badge).

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: Error text on every surface and alert-tint: failing checks, changes requested, crashed sessions, closed PRs.

tokens.name: alert-solid
tokens.usage: Error glyph, failing-check marks, a usage meter projected to hit its cap.

tokens.name: alert-tint
tokens.usage: Background of error pills.

tokens.name: unread
tokens.usage: Your-turn text on every surface and unread-tint: an agent finished and you have not looked yet.

tokens.name: unread-solid
tokens.usage: The Your-turn dot (the unread-mail convention).

tokens.name: unread-tint
tokens.usage: Background of Your-turn pills.

tokens.name: pr-open
tokens.usage: Open or approved PR text and passing checks, on every surface and pr-open-tint (GitHub's green, so it reads without learning).

tokens.name: pr-open-solid
tokens.usage: Open-PR icon and passing-check marks.

tokens.name: pr-open-tint
tokens.usage: Background of open or approved PR chips.

tokens.name: pr-merged
tokens.usage: Merged PR text on every surface and pr-merged-tint (GitHub's purple).

tokens.name: pr-merged-solid
tokens.usage: Merge icon.

tokens.name: pr-merged-tint
tokens.usage: Background of merged PR chips.

tokens.name: neutral-tint
tokens.usage: Background of Working, Idle and draft pills, harness chips, keycaps and meter tracks.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The dot in the Codealong mark, the menu bar count badge and the cover. On light grounds it is 2.2:1: never text or a status mark there (use attn-solid).

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text on brand: the count inside the menu bar badge.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px gap in the surface color (shadow-focus).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind the command palette and sheets.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Usage percentages and big counts. Always tabular figures.

styles.name: callsign
styles.usage: Lane callsigns: the worktree slug, exactly as it appears on disk.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Bay headers and column labels. Set in uppercase.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Panel headings and session titles in the inspector.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Waiting for approval to run a migration
styles.usage: Default UI text: lane headlines, menu items, excerpts.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Button labels and the emphasized part of a headline.

styles.name: code-sm
styles.usage: Harness chips, PR numbers, check counts.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Glyph to label; icon to text inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between chips; inner padding of pills and keycaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding inside lane segments and rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding; gap between inspector sections.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Popover padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between bays; window content inset.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top of a view title; empty-state breathing room.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Status pills, PR chips, keycaps: tags stay square-cornered like a strip's printed boxes.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, menu items.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards and inspector panels.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Popover, command palette, window corners.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Harness chips and meters: the agents riding a lane are round, everything else is square.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Menu bar popover, menus, command palette.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Primary button and the selected segment of a segmented control.

tokens.name: shadow-hud
tokens.usage: The floating bar, which sits over other apps’ windows.

tokens.name: shadow-focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px gap in the surface color, then a solid 2px ink ring.

tokens.name: lane-h
tokens.usage: Lane height on the board (two lines).

tokens.name: lane-h-compact
tokens.usage: Lane height in the menu bar popover and compact density.

tokens.name: row-h
tokens.usage: Sidebar items, menu items, palette rows.

tokens.name: titlebar-h
tokens.usage: Unified window toolbar.

tokens.name: sidebar-w
tokens.usage: Main window sidebar: the project's worktree tree.

tokens.name: inspector-w
tokens.usage: Main window inspector.

tokens.name: popover-w
tokens.usage: Menu bar popover.

tokens.name: palette-w
tokens.usage: Command palette.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: UI icons.

tokens.name: glyph
tokens.usage: Status glyphs.

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Hover and press feedback.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Popover and palette open, lane moving between bays.

tokens.name: dur-sweep
tokens.usage: One turn of the Working glyph. Stops under reduced motion.
